commands: mod graph --output=json (explicit selected modules; optional registries)
registry_options: query, build and mod graph accept explicit file/HTTP/HTTPS registries; remote registries require --lockfile_mode=off; no implicit network registry or lockfile implementation; fresh metadata requests, 404/410 missing, other failures hard errors
custom_rules: rule implementation callbacks, typed scalar/list/label/output attributes, declaration snapshots, None fallback, definition-relative label defaults, canonical main-repository Label strings (@@//), DefaultInfo, frozen custom-provider identity across packages and provider-only generated-file propagation
build_settings: default-only config.bool/int/string/string_list descriptors and rule(build_setting=...), mandatory typed invocation snapshots, help attribute and dynamic ctx.build_setting_value with fresh mutable list copies; actual genuine skylib implementations produce their own providers; no CLI setting overrides or configured-analysis parity; see docs/BUILD_SETTINGS.md
template_variables: native platform_common.TemplateVariableInfo with stable constructor identity, instance identity, ordered string snapshots, fresh mutable variables dictionaries, normal provider return/lookup/ownership semantics and explicit dependency consumers; no implicit Make expansion, ctx.var or toolchain resolution
depsets: persistent DAG; default/postorder/preorder/topological orders; homogeneous File, string, Label, bool, int32 and immutable tuple elements
args: native add/add_all/add_joined, formatting, mapping, deduplication and action-registration snapshots; top-level mapper identity registry, closures require allow_closure=True
module_metadata: native MODULE.bazel evaluation records dependencies, overrides, extension usages, use_repo_rule invocations and registrations; root/dependency context filters direct dev calls before attribute capture and name reservation; declaration metadata does not execute repository rules
module_graph: discovery/MVS, nodep and multiple_version_override selection, selected graph JSON; local single-version patch projection before discovery, with original and evaluated MODULE bytes retained separately; default explicit-module profile; genuine built-ins opt-in; graph commands do not execute extensions
builtin_modules: native-only --experimental-builtin-modules selects genuine Bazel 9.3 bazel_tools injection before discovery/selection; ordered implicit edges, full registry dependency closure and canonical mapping; complete 421-file official Linux x86-64 embedded-tools bundle with native verified publication; MODULE override metadata does not replace canonical builtin filesystem; no runtime upstream engine dependency; default transition and --override_repository remain unsupported; see docs/BUILTIN_MODULES.md
repositories: live local_path_override and registry local_path roots; checksum-verified tar/tar.gz/zip sources, mirrors, overlays, ordered registry text patches, original MODULE replacement and ordered local override text patches; lazy source materialization, canonical/apparent mappings and repository-qualified visibility
patch_profile: bounded UTF-8 unified text modifications/create/delete with explicit file-section boundaries, reverse hunks with exact nearest-offset matching, safe private-stage paths; no fuzz, adjacent ambiguous plain sections, Git binary/rename/copy/mode changes, command execution or generated patch inputs; live local_path sources cannot apply transformations
git_overrides: full 40-hex SHA-1 commit pins over explicit HTTPS/file URLs; isolated system Git, verified private cache, regular files and preserved validated internal file symlinks, full local patches before MODULE evaluation; Linux only, no tags/branches/default HEAD/submodules or credential helpers
git_file_symlinks: committed target bytes verified before checkout and preserved literally; complete and stripped namespaces plus post-patch/warm manifests validated; internal regular-file targets and up to 40 leaf-link hops only; no directory/external/dangling links, linked MODULE, patch-link targets or general action/load/glob symlink support
direct_repository_rules: demanded use_repo_rule exports execute genuine frozen callbacks after whole-usage attribute binding; MODULE-owner canonical mappings and definition-relative label defaults; ctx.attr/name/original_name, synchronous file and binary-preserving ordered template, None returns only
ordinary_module_extensions: non-isolated requested label/symbol identities; typed ordered tags and immutable BFS participant modules; genuine complete callbacks returning None; call-time argument snapshots, deferred sibling label binding, all-repository/all-import validation before demanded file/template execution; no metadata/facts/SDK APIs; see docs/MODULE_EXTENSIONS.md
repository_rule_profile: ASCII Starlark strings/attributes/substitutions and clean relative output paths only; non-ASCII literals, high-byte octal and chr references fail before direct execution; binary template bytes preserved; no execute/download/env/symlink/path objects; callbacks reevaluated per invocation before verified content-addressed publication; see docs/REPOSITORY_RULES.md
repository_cache: isolated under --cache-dir/repositories, staged atomic tree publication and locks; SRI-verified download blobs and rechecked file/mode manifests; cache directories trusted against concurrent hostile mutation, not a sandbox; no offline or lockfile guarantees
archive_limits: 256 MiB downloaded archives, 1 GiB expanded data, 100000 entries; regular UTF-8 files/directories only; links, special files, GNU/PAX extension records and unsafe paths explicitly rejected; file modes normalized to 0644/0755
labels: repository-aware CLI/loading uses RepositorySet::parse and Label::parse_in; legacy Label::parse remains main-repository-only; canonical Starlark strings use @@
external_files: source execution paths external/<canonical>/...; File.short_path ../<canonical>/... is metadata only, never a source lookup or execution path
visibility: private by default; repository-qualified package identity, package defaults, exports, public/private and __pkg__/__subpackages__ scopes enforced
loading: main and materialized external-repository .bzl modules, frozen functions, legacy macros, lexical labels/defaults, native struct and print in .bzl files, glob, package(default_visibility), exports_files
glob: source-only * and ** patterns; package boundaries; Bazel9.3 allow_empty=false default; no symlink traversal
execution: bounded parallel local action DAG via build --jobs=N; strict bash for genrules, non-strict custom run_shell, direct program run; ETXTBSY spawn-only retry capped at 8 attempts with 127 ms total requested backoff, never retries process exits; isolated working directories, NOT a security sandbox
cache: native-action-v5 local content-addressed declared inputs/action payload/outputs; successful regular action outputs normalize to Bazel 9.3 default 0555 after execution; exact output permissions and bytes verified on reuse; source/repository file modes unchanged; writable-output option unsupported; undeclared host dependencies NOT tracked
unsupported: external .bzl loads without materializable source roots
full Git semantics including mutable refs and unrestricted symlinks, archive overrides, full patch semantics and patch commands, unsupported archive formats and links
complete module-extension APIs, isolation, metadata, facts and SDK execution
mod text output, builtin presentation, unused modules and verbose explanations
full repository-rule APIs and byte-string semantics
CLI build-setting overrides, string_set and legacy allow_multiple
implicit template-variable Make expansion and ctx.var
